svg.title: Orison: districts, places and the breached crater
svg.desc: An authored city plan with eleven district envelopes, twenty-four numbered places, a whole-crater inset and a measured coordinate grid. This is a planning illustration, not a terrain survey.
svg.text: CITY-001 · 742 AL · Working plan 0.1 · 420,000 residents in the core
North is up. Distances in kilometers; heights above planning sea level. District envelopes overlap.
Three waterfront locations are supported overwater structures; shore access must be designed.
Mirror Ring is a moving orbital annex and has no ground coordinate. No actual streets, terrain, bathymetry or capacity simulation is claimed.
Source: orison_city_plan.json · Azimuthal equidistant from 17° N, 28° E on the adopted 5,900 km sphere.
